I participate in capture-the-flag security competitions\" vs \"I play capture-the-flag competitions...\"","dimension":"security credibility","description":"This captures the amount of explicit evidence of hands-on security training or offensive-security experience.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"My grounding in data structures and algorithms... replaced ad-hoc traversals with proper graph algorithms\"","dimension":"algorithmic depth","description":"This captures how directly the letter demonstrates experience with algorithms and data-structure reasoning.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"I write and submit the patches upstream rather than waiting on maintainers\"","dimension":"open-source initiative","description":"This captures proactive contribution to external or upstream codebases when security issues are found.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"I am confident the team's standards and my own working habits are well matched\" vs \"I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further and learn where the team most needs help\"","dimension":"tone of self-presentation","description":"This captures whether the letter sounds more assertive and self-assured or more curious and collaborative.","winner":"A"}]}
